decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:LIVARCH/1WR/201 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/202 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/203 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/204 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/205 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/206 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/207 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/208 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/209 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/210 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/211 Rev ALIVARCH/1WR/212 Rev ADesign and Access StatementBiodiversity MetricBiodiversity Net Gain Technical PackagePhase 1 Environmental Report 3220-P1E-1 prepared by GO Contaminated Land Solutions dated 19 March 2026Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) Version 1.0 dated 2 Apr 2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) and the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, or any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting those Orders, the development hereby approved shall be used only for purposes falling within Use Class B2 (General Industrial), Use Class B8 (Storage or Distribution) and Use Class E(g)(iii) (Industrial Processes), and for no other purpose.Reason: To ensure that the use of the premises remains appropriate to the character of the area and the assessment of the application, and to prevent the introduction of alternative uses that could give rise to unacceptable impacts on amenity, traffic or the local environment without further consideration by the Local Planning Authority.

No development shall commence until full details of the proposed rain gardens and green roof have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include, as a minimum:(a) the location, extent and design of the rain gardens, including planting species, substrate specification and drainage capacity; and(b) the location, extent and design of the green roof, including the type of system, substrate depth, planting species mix and a maintenance and management regime.The rain gardens and green roof shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved maintenance and management regime for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the development incorporates sustainable drainage and green infrastructure in the interests of biodiversity, urban greening and sustainable water management

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the four long-stay and two short-stay cycle parking spaces in line with Chapter 8 of the London Cycling Design Standards, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.
